pack.name: AWS Landing Zone / Control Tower
pack.description: Organizations, Control Tower, SCP guardrails, and hub-spoke networking themes. Thematic mapping only; not Control Tower conformance certification.

rules.title: Management group hierarchy documented
rules.description: Platform scope should describe how subscriptions roll up through management groups (corp, landing zone, workload) so policy inheritance and access boundaries are reviewable.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document hierarchy intent in governance.PolicyConstraints; cite SubscriptionId and ScopeDescriptor from awsExtractor.manifest when inventory is present.

rules.title: Subscription vending and workload placement explained
rules.description: Each workload subscription should have a documented purpose, environment class, and owning team when landing-zone vending is in scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Mirror subscription purpose in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.ComplianceTags; align services[].Tags with environment and cost-center keys.

rules.title: Hub-spoke or virtual WAN topology described
rules.description: Connectivity between hub and spoke networks (or Virtual WAN hubs) must be understandable from architecture relationships and governance narrative.
rules.remediationGuidance: Model hub/spoke edges in relationships with AuthenticatesWith/ReadsFrom semantics where applicable; document peering or vWAN attachment in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: AWS Policy initiative alignment stated
rules.description: When AWS Config compliance exports or governance metadata references AWS Policy, non-compliance themes should be dispositioned or risk-accepted with traceable narrative.
rules.remediationGuidance: Summarize initiative gaps in governance.PolicyConstraints; tie SubscriptionId scope to reviewer sign-off in metadata.DecisionTraceIds.

rules.title: Platform identity baseline (IAM Identity Center) documented
rules.description: Landing-zone identity posture should describe privileged access, break-glass, and workload identity patterns (managed identities over long-lived secrets).
rules.remediationGuidance: Encode identity commitments in governance.RequiredControls; tag platform services with identity:* keys on services[].Tags.

rules.title: Centralized logging and monitoring landing zone
rules.description: Diagnostic and audit logs from platform and workload subscriptions should converge to a documented Log Analytics or equivalent sink.
rules.remediationGuidance: Declare observability sink ownership in governance.PolicyConstraints; reference awsExtractor.manifest.ScriptVersion when diagnostic exports accompany the package.

rules.title: Private DNS and name resolution for PaaS
rules.description: Private endpoints and internal DNS zones for PaaS services should be documented when landing-zone standards require private connectivity.
rules.remediationGuidance: Set PrivateEndpointRequired on sensitive datastores[]; document private DNS linkage in relationships and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud posture referenced
rules.description: Platform security baseline should mention Defender plans or secure score themes when regulated workloads are in scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture defender/secure-score commitments in governance.ComplianceTags and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Mandatory resource tagging for FinOps allocation
rules.description: Landing-zone tagging standards (environment, cost center, owner) should be visible on manifest services and reflected in CloudFormation/API inventory when exported.
rules.remediationGuidance: Audit services[].Tags and governance.ComplianceTags against mandatory tag policy; correlate with resources.json tag columns when extractor output is available.

rules.title: Segregation of duties for platform operations
rules.description: Platform team roles (network, security, identity, workload) should show separation in governance metadata when SOX or regulated controls apply.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document RACI or SoD statements in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Connectivity subscription boundaries for shared services
rules.description: Shared services (firewall, DNS, bastion, ACR) should declare which subscription hosts them and how spokes consume them.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe shared-service placement in governance.PolicyConstraints; link consuming workloads via relationships.

rules.title: Evidence freshness for landing-zone reviews
rules.description: Reviews citing AWS inventory must record collection timestamp and extractor switches so landing-zone drift is auditable.
rules.remediationGuidance: Cite awsExtractor.manifest.CollectionTimestamp, SchemaVersion, and SwitchesUsed in metadata.ChangeDescription.
